# usage

Masthead usage bars, per-model weekly bar, per-session context gauge, usage poll and Keychain read.

- Spec: `docs/features/usage/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/usage/contract.md`

## Protocol

- `usage.refresh` — `POST /api/usage/refresh`
- `ws.usage` — The Usage object & `usage` message

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/canary-cache-test-follows-live-regime` — The server picks the main thread's cache regime, so the canary asserts the idle behaviour of whichever regime it sees and fails only on an unknown ttl. (accepted, 2026-10-26; features: canary, usage) → `docs/adr/canary-cache-test-follows-live-regime.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only` — The canary writes statusLine.refreshInterval, a settings key production never writes, so the idle-tick fact has a guard. (accepted, 2026-09-12; features: canary, usage, ingest) → `docs/adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-timer-tinted-wherever-cache-warmth-known` — Where cache warmth is known, in any state, the card timer fades from foreground to grey over the lifetime, underlined in its last 15%; group headers show one. (accepted, 2026-10-14; features: rail, groups, usage) → `docs/adr/rail-timer-tinted-wherever-cache-warmth-known.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-all-windows-polled-and-refetched-at-reset` — The OAuth usage fetch feeds the 5h, 7d and per-model bars and runs at each known reset; status line and fetch both feed 5h/7d, newest arrival wins. (accepted, 2026-10-26; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-all-windows-polled-and-refetched-at-reset.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-cache-warmth-follows-keepalive-horizon` — Warmth's expiry is the predicted cold time — an hour of keep-alives after the last request plus the ttl — cut short by warm false or an ended session. (accepted, 2026-10-15; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/usage-cache-warmth-follows-keepalive-horizon.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-call-resets-rounded-up-to-the-second` — The usage call's resets_at is rounded up to the whole second at the adapter and percentages compare with a float tolerance, so both sources de-dup. (accepted, 2026-10-26; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-call-resets-rounded-up-to-the-second.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-context-gauge-shows-tokens-and-compactions` — The context gauge shows the percentage together with absolute input tokens and a compaction counter, because the percentage alone misleads. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-context-gauge-shows-tokens-and-compactions.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-history-persisted-not-rendered` — Usage samples are persisted as history in v1 but no history UI is built; any timeline joins the post-v1 attention-ribbon family. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-history-persisted-not-rendered.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only` — The daemon reads Claude Code's OAuth token from the macOS Keychain read-only for usage polling; never logged, stored or sent on the wire; tests use file seams. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-keychain-token-read-only.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-narrow-width-shrinks-bars` — The masthead never wraps its text; below 1840px its gaps tighten and bars drop to 40px. No readout truncates now the model readout is gone. (accepted, 2026-10-12; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-narrow-width-shrinks-bars.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window` — The wire carries every model-scoped weekly window; the masthead shows one, chosen by a selector and persisted as a preference with a default model. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage, settings) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-shows-no-model` — The masthead shows no model and the usage object drops its model field; the model shows per session only, and usage history still records it. (accepted, 2026-10-12; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-shows-no-model.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart` — Account usage reads unknown after a daemon restart until the next status post; per-session context persists on the session row. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-hydration-across-restart.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-no-source-interface` — Usage sources share a neutral Sample type and one aggregator, with no Go interface type until a second source forces one. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-no-source-interface.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-past-reset-reads-unknown` — A usage bar whose reset has passed reads unknown until a fresh value arrives, and the daemon never adopts a value already past its reset. (accepted, 2026-10-26; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-past-reset-reads-unknown.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-reset-time-bracketed` — Each masthead usage readout shows its reset as (HH:MM) when it falls today and (HH:MM Ddd) otherwise, with the full date and time on hover. (accepted, 2026-10-12; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-reset-time-bracketed.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value` — A usage sample is recorded and broadcast only when its bucket values or model changed; duplicates are dropped by value, not by timestamp. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-sample-dedup-by-value.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track` — An unknown gauge renders the word unknown with no track drawn; a zero-filled track is forbidden because it reads as zero percent used. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-unknown-renders-word-not-track.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/context-window-shape` — context_window carries context_window_size, used/remaining_percentage on a 0-100 scale, token totals and a current_usage object. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/context-window-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/custom-base-url-selects-1h-cache` — A session with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL set reports prompt_cache ttl "1h"; the same model reached directly or through HTTPS_PROXY reports "5m". (active, 2026-10-15; verified 2.1.300..2.1.300; features: usage) → `docs/facts/custom-base-url-selects-1h-cache.md`
- `kb:fact/effort-changes-mid-session` — /effort changes the level at once with only the status line saying so; the chosen effort survives /model, re-clamped per model; no hook carries it. (active, 2026-10-15; verified 2.1.300..2.1.300; features: ingest, usage) → `docs/facts/effort-changes-mid-session.md`
- `kb:fact/haiku-main-cache-ttl-5m-on-2-1-299` — On 2.1.299–2.1.300 a Haiku session's main thread writes 5-minute cache and prompt_cache reports ttl "5m", where 2.1.259–2.1.296 reported "1h". (active, 2026-10-14; verified 2.1.299..2.1.300; features: usage) → `docs/facts/haiku-main-cache-ttl-5m-on-2-1-299.md`
- `kb:fact/main-cache-ttl-selected-per-model-off-binary` — The main thread's cache TTL (5m or 1h) is switched per model on dates, not by Claude Code releases; one binary wrote 5m on 2026-10-22 and 1h on 2026-10-26. (active, 2026-10-26; verified 2.1.296..2.1.308; features: usage, canary) → `docs/facts/main-cache-ttl-selected-per-model-off-binary.md`
- `kb:fact/model-switch-hooks` — /model fires PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch (from_model, to_model, source); the status line shows the new model at once, before any prompt. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.316; features: ingest, lifecycle, usage) → `docs/facts/model-switch-hooks.md`
- `kb:fact/oauth-token-in-keychain` — The subscription OAuth token lives in the macOS Keychain item "Claude Code-credentials" as claudeAiOauth.accessToken. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/oauth-token-in-keychain.md`
- `kb:fact/otel-usage-metrics-shape` — Claude Code's OTel export carries cost in USD and tokens by type as DELTA sums keyed on Claude's session_id, with identity attributes on every point. (active, 2026-09-13; verified 2.1.269..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/otel-usage-metrics-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/prompt-cache-1h-no-keepalive-warm-flips-at-expiry` — In the 1h regime an idle session sends no keep-alive; expires_at holds at last request + 3600 s and warm turns false on the first post at that second. (active, 2026-10-26; verified 2.1.308..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/prompt-cache-1h-no-keepalive-warm-flips-at-expiry.md`
- `kb:fact/prompt-cache-5m-keepalive` — A 5m-ttl session idles with a keep-alive every 30 s for an hour after its last request; expires_at is the last keep-alive plus 300 s. (active, 2026-10-15; verified 2.1.300..2.1.300; features: usage) → `docs/facts/prompt-cache-5m-keepalive.md`
- `kb:fact/prompt-cache-outage-goes-cold-after-ttl` — An outage or frozen process shorter than the 5m ttl loses nothing; a longer one reads warm false at expires_at and nothing re-warms it. (active, 2026-10-15; verified 2.1.300..2.1.300; features: usage) → `docs/facts/prompt-cache-outage-goes-cold-after-ttl.md`
- `kb:fact/prompt-cache-status-shape` — Status-line prompt_cache gives the main thread's cache — warm, ttl "1h", expires_at in epoch seconds a TTL after the last request; absent until a request. (active, 2026-10-14; verified 2.1.259..2.1.296; features: usage) → `docs/facts/prompt-cache-status-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limit-resets-differ-in-precision-across-sources` — Status-line rate-limit resets fall on whole 10-minute boundaries; the usage API states the same window with microseconds just before one. (active, 2026-10-26; verified 2.1.237..2.1.310; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limit-resets-differ-in-precision-across-sources.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limits-wire-shape` — rate_limits has five_hour and seven_day buckets (not weekly), each {used_percentage: float, resets_at: Unix epoch integer}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limits-wire-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/refresh-interval-seconds` — statusLine.refreshInterval is in seconds, not milliseconds, and ticks while idle; without it an idle session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/refresh-interval-seconds.md`
- `kb:fact/resume-reads-prior-prompt-cache` — A resume inside the cache TTL reads the previous process's prompt cache on its first request; prompt_cache stays absent until that request. (active, 2026-10-14; verified 2.1.299..2.1.300; features: usage, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-reads-prior-prompt-cache.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-around-failed-turns` — A failed turn gets one status post with no new usage; an all-failing session shows null context, and rate_limits only if an error response carries the headers. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.280..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-around-failed-turns.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-cost-is-local-estimate` — Status-line cost.total_cost_usd is built unconditionally on every auth mode and matches the summed OTel cost, but is a list-price estimate, not an invoice. (active, 2026-09-13; verified 2.1.269..2.1.269; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-cost-is-local-estimate.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-effort-key` — The status line has effort{level} only while the model supports effort; it tracks --effort and /effort at once, and /effort fires no hook. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-effort-key.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-has-no-model-bucket` — The status line carries only five_hour and seven_day (plus spend_limit on gateway accounts); the per-model weekly window is never copied in. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-has-no-model-bucket.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-keys` — Status-line top-level keys; permission_mode is never among them. Newer versions add scratchpad_dir and prompt_cache (superset). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/status-line-keys.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs` — Status-line posts are event-driven, ~50 ms after tool activity, and arrive in close pairs a median 435 ms apart. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-cache-ttl-5m` — Subagents write their prompt cache with the 5-minute TTL while the main thread writes 1-hour; the status line reports only the main thread's cache. (active, 2026-10-13; verified 2.1.296..2.1.296; features: usage) → `docs/facts/subagent-cache-ttl-5m.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-before-first-response` — Before a session's first API response rate_limits is absent and the context percentages are null: unknown, not 0%. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/unknown-before-first-response.md`
- `kb:fact/usage-api-oauth-shape` — GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth bearer and anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 returns five_hour, seven_day and limits[]. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.316; features: usage) → `docs/facts/usage-api-oauth-shape.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/plan-asserted-surface-nobody-defined` — An E criterion asserted a card readout no plan section defined; a composed text pattern carried a middot the mockup never had. Guessed markup, false pattern. (active, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/lessons/plan-asserted-surface-nobody-defined.md`
- `kb:lesson/select-rebuilt-every-tick-passed-selectoption` — A <select> rebuilt every 1 s tick had no keyboard use, yet seven criteria stayed green via selectOption; a name-only cache key then disabled an option. (active, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/lessons/select-rebuilt-every-tick-passed-selectoption.md`
- `kb:lesson/stale-fixture-reshaped-the-wire` — An omitempty added to keep a frozen snapshot green changed the wire and was reverted mid-wave; a gauge bar shipped misordered to fit a textContent fake. (active, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/lessons/stale-fixture-reshaped-the-wire.md`
- `kb:lesson/two-wire-shapes-accepted-hides-disagreement` — An invented {id, display_name} hook field survived two stages because the daemon accepted both shapes: every test green, contract wrong, Opus probe needed. (active, 2026-08-22; features: ingest, usage) → `docs/lessons/two-wire-shapes-accepted-hides-disagreement.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/nongoal-cost-tracking` — No cost or spend tracking; on a subscription the usage windows are the real constraint, so the gauges show limits, not money. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/nongoal-cost-tracking.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-resource-gauges` — No CPU or memory gauges per session or for the machine; usage means Claude usage limits and context, never host resources. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: usage) → `docs/adr/nongoal-resource-gauges.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name` — A session's displayed title is read from the status line's session_name, which reflects --name, /rename and the auto-generated title alike. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rename, usage) → `docs/adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-cache-warmth-kept-until-clear-read-against-client-clock` — The Session carries the prompt cache's expiry and lifetime, persisted and cleared only by /clear; the dashboard compares the expiry with its own clock. (superseded, 2026-10-14; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/usage-cache-warmth-kept-until-clear-read-against-client-clock.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample` — The masthead shows the model from the freshest usage sample; flicker under mixed-model sessions is accepted. (superseded, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-model-from-freshest-sample.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-narrow-width-shrinks-bars-truncates-model` — The masthead never wraps its text; below 1840px its gaps tighten and bars drop to 40px, and only the model name truncates, with a hover title. (superseded, 2026-09-23; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-narrow-width-shrinks-bars-truncates-model.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-model-window-polled-from-oauth-api` — The per-model weekly window comes from the daemon polling Claude Code's OAuth usage endpoint on a timer plus a coalesced manual refresh, not the status line. (superseded, 2026-08-30; features: usage) → `docs/adr/usage-model-window-polled-from-oauth-api.md`
- `kb:lesson/validate-red-blamed-on-implementation` — 10 of 12 specs failed against a stale prebuilt daemon and looked like implementation bugs; both Criticals were pre-existing specs asserting the old wire shape. (retired, 2026-08-23; features: usage) → `docs/lessons/validate-red-blamed-on-implementation.md`
